Episode 214. Siblings (2)
Luntia Runcandel.
She was currently bound in a subspace of the Coldran snowfield.
"I guess so, hearing about that guy has been heart-wrenching."
Jin recalled the way Luna always treated Luntia difficultly. Luntia was the only sibling who could speak out even during Luna's most ferocious times.
The siblings rode the red owl first to Tikan. This was because they needed a veil to enter the subspace of the Coldran snowfield.
"I'm glad that Bale, the knight of a thousand years ago, is helping the family again."
"Hmph, what's so fortunate about that! It's just because I foolishly misjudged and laid the golden rule."
"If the youngest gets too out of line, let me know."
"Oh, then what happens!? Can I scold that guy who doesn't even know how to respect his ancestors!?"
"No, nothing special will happen. It just means you can vent to me."
"Sister, big sister! Can I call you big sister? Lady Luna. Haha, I am Sandra Zipfel, soon to be Jin's wife. I look forward to working with you!"
"Sure, Sandra Zipfel."

"Luna sister, ignore what that weird girl says. Now that we're allies and I can't kill her, it's frustrating. I didn't like her from the first time I saw her in the Sota desert, I should have killed her then."
"Ah, our little sister is like this again. Actually, you like Sandra."
"Ugh, get away from me!"
Fearlessly, Sandra hugged Yona and let out a giggle. To Luna's eyes, Yona looked nice, being flustered like a normal person.

"Oh, our little sister is so cute. Being grumpy is really adorable, huh? Anyway, hey! Bale, take good care of Jin and our sisters, the masters. If you serve them uncomfortably or make a mistake, I'll give you a punch when we get back."
"Ha... How did my life come to this point. Ah, okay, okay, stop shouting......"
"Jin, you're going to see that girl Luntia, right?"
"Yes, Lady Ameris."
"Then, how about I accompany you? It may seem odd for me to join in a gathering of siblings, but ever since I first heard about that child, I thought I might be able to help."
"I was planning to ask you to join us before we set off. Let's go together."
So, the siblings, Bale, and Ameris rode the red owl again towards the Coldran snowfield. The snowfield spread out white and was in the middle of a blizzard.

When he went to see Luntia for the first time after the end of the demon war, Jin was very anxious. The inside of the subspace was filled with evil energy, and Luntia may have lost her sanity and become a monster.
However, for some reason, I now felt anticipation. Perhaps it was the anticipation that today, Luntia might escape from the subspace and return to the family.
Baeil entered the cave and transformed, releasing his power. As the golden aura filled the interior of the cave, a dimensional gate leading to subspace was formed.
‘The spirit energy… it's faded since the last time I visited.'
The moment they entered, it was clearly felt. The brothers, seeing Jin's expression, guessed that something good had changed in the subspace.
[Oh… What's happening here?]
Luntia was revealing herself from the darkness.
[It's been a long time, siblings. I never thought I'd be so glad to see you.]
“Luntia……”
Luna and the brothers approached Luntia.
Even though they hadn't talked yet, the brothers recognized at a glance that each of them had changed a bit.
[You must have had a hard time in the Black Sea, sister, but you seem to have healed a lot. Did father return too?]
“No, just me, Uncle Zed, and the former Black Knight came back first. You're still turning your back on the world, like before."

[Does it look like that? I had changed like that before being trapped here. Since the moment I broke when the youngest declared the head of the house, I've regained some meaning in life. Although I ended up like this before I got to try anything properly.]
"Hmm, hmm! Such a state, Sister Luntia. You're too cool."
“That's right, sister. While you've been training here, we've been working hard too.”
“When did these fools become friendly with Luntia sister to butter her up?”
"Oh, then, did Sister Mary befriend Sister Luntia? We can become closer from now on."

“Well, that's true. Wow, our Luntia sister. I thought when I could catch up to you because you were so strong before, but now there's no answer? I can feel it right away, how much stronger you've become. I don't even know who would win if you fought with big sister?"
[That's not the case, Mary. Yona, why are you shivering like this?]
“He…… I want to touch your horn, sister.”
When Yona suddenly mentioned the horn, the brothers glanced around, surprised. Luntia giggled and ruffled Yona's hair.
Along with the horn, the connecting point that ties Luntia to the subspace was also the same.
[Touching such an ugly thing like this will make you feel negative, Yona. It will disappear when I regain my old form. The youngest promised to help.]
“Yeah, I didn't say I wanted to touch it because it's cute or pretty, but because I was curious if I could ring the bell. It's nice to talk to you, sister, hehe.”
[Me too, Yona. When I get out of here, let's hang out more often. By the way, Jin, who is this person?]
"It's Ameris, sister. An existence that has protected the world since ancient times."

"I heard that time passes faster here than outside. There might not be enough time to converse among siblings, so it would be better to hear about me in detail after you get out. However, the reason I came here is to help you, so that might happen today."
[Could it possibly mean you can take me out?]
"Judging by your condition, it seems possible. The stale energy here is thinner than what Jin told me."
At his words, Jin and the siblings' eyes widened.

Especially Jin, even though he visited this place with an odd sense of anticipation, he didn't expect Ameris to be able to provide an immediate answer. He thought that liberating Luntia would be possible only when Vahn returned.
[Ah, the soul energy... It faded suddenly when I saw the results of my training a while ago.]
"It's probably the result of gaining something profound through training and acquiring a special power. Like Jin's Eternity and Luna's Red Sword Energy."
[A special power… I haven't gained any new secret techniques or decisive moves. I have merely honed the swords I've been familiarizing myself with.]
"That power does not necessarily take the form of martial arts or skills. There must have been some change in you. Think carefully."
[Ah, now that you mention it. For a few days, when I raised my energy, a strange light would swirl in my palm.]
"Show me."
As Luntia began to release her energy, the siblings had no choice but to be surprised again. Incredibly clear and powerful aura and magic were vibrating throughout the entire space.
"Ho-ho, my assumption was correct."
A look of interest filled the eyes of Ameris as he inspected Luntia's palm.
[I don’t know what this light means. It's just a faint light... and I don't feel like it's making my sword stronger.]
"This is the result of your will finally taking form and manifesting."
[My will...?]
"If you don’t know, I can't tell what it means either. The will of existence tends to take different forms when it manifests. However, upon closer inspection, this light looks like a star."
"Listening to Ameris' words, it does look like a star. There are two in the left hand and one in the right."
"Hee, it's really pretty. I have to touch this."
"You must have revered the stars for a long time, or wanted to become a star yourself. Whether in a symbolic sense or in a literal sense."
At Ameris' words, Luntia reflected on her past days for a moment.
'Stars... stars.'
Revering the stars, and the desire to become a star.
Suddenly, she remembered the stories her nanny Lesham told her when she was a girl.
"Miss, you too can become a grand star like Miss Luna. This nanny dreams of the day when you rise to the sky and become a star shining brighter than Miss Luna."
It was the day she had lost to Luna and laid on the hill, endlessly watching the stars.
'Yes... from then on, the biggest star to me was Luna.'
And after Luna renounced the throne, Luntia lost the meaning of her life. In the midst of days filled with meaningless serenity and languor.
Newly, a star called the youngest rose in her heart. After she lost to Jin at the declaration of the master.
"Miss, I wish you good luck. As I have always done, and forever will."
The day after the declaration of the master, Lesham shed tears sensing that a new star had risen in Luntia.
'The two stars in the left hand are Luna and the youngest... and the right hand, myself...'
Luntia turned her head and looked at her stars standing beside her.
"I think I know what these stars mean, Ameris."
"Oh, Ru, Luntia! Your voice...!"
"Your voice is back to normal!"
The Tona brothers yelled as they heard Luntia's suddenly changed voice. They could no longer find the dark resonance unique to chaos in her voice.
The stars she held in her hands were emitting an even clearer and stronger light.
And Luntia realized.
It was the price of not giving up on life even after being betrayed by her mother, sacrificing herself for Lesham, and becoming a monster. She finally became a star, like Luna and Jin.
She defeated despair and languor and grasped light in her hands.
"All I had to do was inform you of the meaning of the power you've gained. The soul energy is already being absorbed into those stars."
The soul energy of the space was being sucked into Luntia's palms. Then the connection points began to dissolve, but it didn't harm Luntia.
"Ho-ho, it seems now it's your turn to confine the space within you. Even if I didn't come, as long as you realized the meaning of that light by yourself. You could've escaped from here at any time."
The reason why Luntia's star could absorb soul energy was that she continued to shine.
To eliminate the darkness that blocks light. Luntia's will, who revered and desired the stars, was shining in itself.
Soon the whole space disappeared into Luntia's palm. Standing on the cave floor, Luntia looked back at her brothers.
Without deciding who would go first, the brothers hugged each other. In the cold of the snowfield, the brothers felt each other's body heat.
It was the first time this happened since they were born as siblings.
